The 8th U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals issued a one-sentence order late Thursday. It puts the Environmental Protection Agency’s emergency permit on hold until the court rules on a request to block the blasts at the Iowa Army Ammunition Plant in Middletown, near Burlington.

A spokesperson for the Iowa Environmental Council said the court could still rule before Monday, leaving open the possibility the blasts go ahead as scheduled.
